scope: Locally authored AC1018 TABLESTYLE extension XRECORD-shaped selected frame, using generic verified-XRECORD reader plus the independent bounded profile observer. This does not construct or validate the complete stronger TABLESTYLE bundle or authorize output.
generation: The test writes an AC1018 drawing from a locally authored DRW_XRecord with ten ordered values and H4 owner/reactor. It replaces the body with a locally generated bit-buffer version carrying RS length and observed page byte 45, recomputes object CRC and enclosing uncompressed page checksums, and verifies frame reread. All drawings are scratch-only.
controls: A real reader-origin XRECORD ticket and bounded profile observer accept the generated source.

A locally regenerated, equal-size group-90 value mutation retains a valid object CRC and valid page checksums; the generic verified reader ticket still succeeds while the profile observer rejects the changed value.

The test corrupts the selected frame CRC while recomputing the enclosing page data/header checksums, verifies the candidate is revoked and untruncated diagnostics contain ObjectFrameBounds for 0xdc with no DataPageChecksum or DataPageCrc failure, then restores the source and retries the same reader successfully.
full_bundle_feasibility: Separately, a scratch variant of the existing complete TABLE whole-file writer with locally generated 2104-byte proxy wrote and read a valid AC1018 TABLE and empty extension dictionary; a CRC-validated captured TABLE frame passed DwgTableEntityXDictionaryAc1018Candidate. As of this receipt, a generated complete eleven-XRECORD TABLESTYLE bundle and its selected-frame valid-CRC and bad-CRC whole-bundle failure controls remain open.
limits: No non-ASCII semantics or source interoperability is inferred. The generic ticket and profile observer are tested together, not the stronger eleven-XRECORD graph gate. No drawing fixture was added.
